findings.message: uses a shell-enabled process API in Python or .NET code
findings.remediation: Avoid shell execution; pass a fixed argv array and reject untrusted input before spawning.
findings.impact: Shell-enabled Python or .NET process APIs can execute attacker-controlled commands with host privileges.
findings.attack_vector: os.system/os.popen, subprocess(..., shell=True), or ProcessStartInfo.UseShellExecute=true receives untrusted input.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
